name: ColorWheel
description:
A colour wheel: a hue and an amount around a neutral centre, the control for a colour balance,
a grade's shadows, midtones and highlights, or a tint. The value is `{ hue, amount }`: the OKLCH
hue in degrees, at its angle on the wheel (0° to the right of the centre, rising
counter-clockwise, in every language, as in a chart), and the amount from 0 at the centre to
`max` at the rim. The disc runs from grey at the centre to each hue's most saturated sRGB colour
at the rim, so pure red, yellow, green, cyan, blue and magenta sit on its edge;
`colorWheelColor` gives the colour under the bead.

Pointer: press or drag anywhere on the wheel; a double press returns to neutral.

Keyboard: the wheel is one tab stop holding two sliders, Hue and Amount. Left and Right turn the
hue (Right raises the angle; in a right-to-left language the keys swap, as in every slider). Up
and Down change the amount, outward and back. Shift with an arrow takes ten steps; Page Up and
Page Down change the amount by ten steps; Home returns to neutral and End goes to the rim, both
keeping the hue. Focus moves to the slider whose value the key changed, so a screen reader
speaks the value that moved: the hue as its colour family and angle ("Green, 142°"), the
amount as a percentage of `max`, or "Neutral" at the centre. At the centre the hue is kept, so
the next step outward continues in it.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommitted, max, step, hueStep, format, readout, size, variant, disabled, locale: localeProp, labels, className, id, "aria-label": ariaLabel, "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy, "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedBy, }: ColorWheelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of elements that describe the wheel's group.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the wheel's group ("Shadows") when no visible label names it. Default "Colour wheel".

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the wheel's group.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Default `{ hue: 0, amount: 0 }`, neutral.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount in the readout and in its spoken value. Default: a percentage of `max` in the locale's form.

props.name: hueStep
props.description: Degrees per arrow key; pointer values snap to it too. Default 1. Shift takes ten.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ wheel: string; hue: string; amount: string; hueValue: ({ name, angle }: { name: string; angle: string; }) => string; neutral: string; readout: ({ angle, amount }: { angle: string; amount: string; }) => string; hueRed: string; hueOrange: string; hueYellow: string; hueGreen: string; hueCyan: string; hueBlue: string; huePurple: string; hueMagenta: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: max
props.description: The amount at the rim. Default 100. The value never goes past it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change, while dragging too.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called once per gesture with the final value: when the pointer is released, on each key press, on a double press back to neutral. Not called when the gesture changed nothing.

props.name: readout
props.description: Show the hue and amount under the wheel ("142° · 35%", or "Neutral"). Its line is reserved, so nothing moves as it changes. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) or `sm`, a smaller wheel and bead for tool panels, matching ColorPicker's sizes. The wheel shrinks to fit a narrower box; its hit area is the whole disc.

props.name: step
props.description: The amount per arrow key; pointer values snap to it too. Default `max / 100`. Shift and Page Up/Down take ten.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: `hue` in degrees and `amount` from 0 (neutral) to `max`. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`disc` (default): the colour disc itself, grey at the centre and full colour at the rim, so the
colour under the bead is the colour chosen. `ring`: a hue ring around a recessed neutral well,
a quieter look where several wheels sit side by side; the bead carries the colour.
